```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)
library(presto)
library(tidyr)
```


```{r}
pbmc <- Read10X(data.dir = "filtered_gene_bc_matrices/hg19/")
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc, project = "pbmc3k", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
pbmc

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.3)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap")

pbmc$barcodes <- colnames(pbmc)
pbmc$fake.sample <- sample(1:5, ncol(pbmc), replace = TRUE)
pbmc$Dx <- ifelse(pbmc$fake.sample %in% c(1,2), "DISEASE", "CONTROL")
pbmc$Dx2 <- ifelse(pbmc$fake.sample %in% c(1,4), "DISEASE",
                   ifelse(pbmc$fake.sample == 2, "CONTROL", "Third Option"))
pbmc.save <- pbmc
DimPlot(pbmc, group.by = "fake.sample")
DimPlot(pbmc, group.by = "Dx")
table(pbmc$fake.sample)

DimPlot(pbmc, label = T)

Idents(pbmc)
markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, min.pct = .1, only.pos = T)

pbmc <- RenameIdents(object = pbmc,
                    "0" = "T_Naive",
                    "1" = "Mono",
                    "2" = "B",
                    "3" = "T_eff",
                    "4" = "Mono2",
                    "5" = "NKT",
                    "6" = "DC",
                    "7" = "Platelets")
pbmc$celltype <- Idents(pbmc)


ss <- subset(pbmc, nCount_RNA >1000)
```

```{r}
# test
df.celltypes <- r2prop_df(pbmc, sample_col = "fake.sample", celltype_col = "celltype", group_col = "Dx")

ggplot(df.celltypes,
       aes(x = Dx, y = proportion, fill = Dx)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Dx),
              width = 0.15, size = 1.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ celltype, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```


```{r}
group_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 8, name = "Dark2")
group_colors <- viridis::inferno(n = 8, direction = -1)
```


```{r}
# All functions:
r2heatmap(seurat_obj = pbmc, FindAllMarkersObj = markers, ncells = 100, group_by = "celltype",viridis_color = T, nfeatures = 5, arrange_by = "dif", barcode_column = "barcodes", group_colors = group_colors)

r2prop_plot(pbmc, group.by = "fake.sample", celltype = "celltype", reorder = T)

ss <- r2sample_seurat(seurat_obj = pbmc, group_var = "fake.sample", n = 200, barcode_column = "barcodes")

markers.ss <- r2subset_markers(markers.result = markers, arrange_by = "p_val_adj", nfeatures = 10, clusters = "cluster", order = "increasing")

r2correlate_samples(seurat_obj = pbmc, group_by = "fake.sample", assay = "RNA", return_heatmap = T)
```
